stem: The incomplete table summarizes the 250 visitors to a science museum one morning and whether each visitor rented an audio guide. If a visitor who rented an audio guide is selected at random, what is the probability that the visitor is a child?
solution: Children who rented an audio guide: \(90 - 54 = 36\).
The condition is “rented an audio guide,” so the denominator is 90.
verify:
r = figure['rows']
child_guide = int(r[2][1]) - int(r[0][1])

p = Rational(child_guide, int(r[2][1]))
